messages:
alex_sales: Quick: Polaris Bio (seed, genomics analytics) requests an 8-week hosted trial to validate embedding search over de-identified lab reports. They ask for $4,500 in promo credits to smooth spikes and access to 45-day metrics retention. Deal: https://redwood.internal/deals/PB-77

carmen_se: Tech note — most cost comes from dense embedding calls. Recommend using the compact-embed model and a 1-week ramp. SE can provide a harness to throttle parallel calls. Estimate: $3k–$6k if unthrottled; with ramping $2k–$4k.

rachel_dealdesk: Discretionary promo pool covers up to $6k, so $4.5k is within discretionary. Need pilot start/end, hosted vs Dedicated, any KMS/DPA requirements, and expiry for promo code. Also confirm conversion incentive.

alex_sales: Details: requested $4,500 credits; pilot 2026-07-06 to 2026-08-31 (8 weeks); hosted only; data will be de-identified, NDA signed, DPA in progress. They want 45-day metrics retention. They asked if this could be part of the startup program for extra month of credits.

toni_security: We require DPA before any live clinical or genomic data. For de-identified data we accept attestation + sample. 45-day retention OK but add to MOU. No KMS or Dedicated access until DPA.

ben_finance: Finance: promos >$5k need RevOps; this one at $4.5k is fine but still needs promo code and GL mapping. Please send billing ticket with deal id PB-77. GL: PROMO/2026/Q3.

rachel_dealdesk: Proposed deal: approve $4,500 hosted credits, 45-day metrics retention, promo expires 30 days after pilot start. Include a conversion incentive: 20% off first month if they sign a 12-mo Dedicated reserve within 60 days after pilot. If they push for startup program additional credits, they should apply separately; we can fast-track review.

alex_sales: I'll present the $4.5k + 20% conversion incentive. I'll also ask them to enroll in the startup program portal; if they qualify we can stack an extra $1k grant subject to program approval.

carmen_se: Config suggestion to limit spend:

```
model: redwood/embedding-compact-v1
batch_size: 128
rate_limit: 50req/s
```

This keeps embedding churn manageable.

rachel_dealdesk: Conditional approval: $4,500 credits. Deal desk updated. Please upload DPA and sample dataset and create billing ticket. If startup grant applies, we'll approve an additional $1k on program basis.

toni_security: Confirmed: no PHI before DPA. We can allow synthetic runs earlier. Add attestation file to the deal folder.

ben_finance: Billing ticket created. Promo code pending; email billing@redwood with PB-77 and cc finance. GL set.

dara_vp: Good. Approve $4.5k by Deal Desk. If the customer requests stacking beyond program rules, escalate to me with a short ROI note.

alex_sales: Thanks all — I will loop in the customer and post back with signed DPA or request for escalation. :rocket:
